summary: prototypeNeedsColor (src/engine/skills/colorChooser.ts) only scans gem create/transform/clear params and ifCond; a modifier source { kind: 'boardGems', color: 'CHOSEN' } is not detected, so a skill whose only use of the chosen colour is a count modifier never asks for a colour and the count reads 0. troop:6704 spell 8060 (native CountGems 100 FromTarget ; CreateGems Red UseCounterForAmount) creates 0 Red instead of one per gem of the chosen colour. Fix: also scan segment.modifier / params.modifier / countModifier / chanceBoost sources (and sources[]) for color 'CHOSEN'. Other curated users of boardGems CHOSEN (batch-13:242, 19:208, 30:85, r1:76, r12:149, r18:385, r19:89, r22:650/765/834) should be re-checked; most also have a CHOSEN gem op and are unaffected.
repro: castSpell({ key: 'troop:6704', color: BaseColor.Blue }) -> order ['status E12 +bleed'] only; expected 'convert … -> Red x11' first (11 Blue on reviewBoard)
